issues.desc: No checklist item requires a user-observable verification of real token usage output (e.g., a transcript showing actual provider-reported token counts attributed to a story after a dispatch). All 5 items are engineering-internal. The smoke test cannot exercise a live dispatch (acknowledged in CHK-005), but no integration or manual verification step fills that gap. Recommend adding a DONE-phase verification or evidence requirement so product acceptance at wrap-up has a concrete transcript to evaluate.
